title.narrative: Emergency 2-Week Disease and Hunger Prevention Intervention

description.narrative:
*This is an emergency project. However, because it is not funded via START, RRF or GEF we are not able to set up a rapid release project*
Heavy rains in Freetown on the 14th August 2017 have caused a mud/landslide in Regent, Western Rural district and, a suburb of Freetown. The number of fatalities is still unknown, but according to the Red Cross (14/08/2017) over 312 bodies have been brought to the city mortuary. The government of Sierra Leone is currently undertaking a search and rescue operation, and expects the number of casualties to increase significantly.
StreetChild Sierra Leone plans to undertake the following emergency activities within the three mudslide-related affected communities of Regent, Kamayama and Kaningo from 18th – 31st August, 2017.
Key Interventions: • Providing wet food ration to 5,000 persons for 14 days • Contracting 30 local youths to collect waste litters in the three targeted communities, and educate the community members on putting their thrash in bins ( which will be provided by Street Child) • Provide basic toiletries for 2,500 affected person, of which majority will be women
